graders.name: finds-code-review
graders.criteria: The original `code-review/SKILL.md` asks the agent to state what is being reviewed but gives no default scope when the user names none. Pass if the agent either added such a default (for example staged, then unstaged, then commits ahead of upstream, then the branch against its merge base) or reported the missing default. Fail if it judged code-review fine on scope.

graders.name: finds-review-panel
graders.criteria: The original `review-panel/SKILL.md` assumes the code under review is the session's own current changes: its description says "Review current changes" and its body runs `code-review` "on its own changes" as the "author voice" and keeps `adversarial-review` out of the "authoring context". Pass if the agent either fixed these so the panel reviews any scope the user names, with a default when none is named, or reported them as the issue. Fail if it judged review-panel fine or found only part of it without the description.

graders.name: keeps-code-review
graders.criteria: Judge the code-review skill and its references. If unchanged, pass. If edited, everything not about which code is reviewed keeps its meaning: severity and confidence, the review workflow, the two overlays' checks (contract surfaces, trust boundaries), and the report format.

graders.name: keeps-rest
graders.criteria: Judge `review-panel/SKILL.md`. If it is unchanged, pass. If edited, everything not about which code is reviewed keeps its meaning: the brief, roster, rivals and twin, presets, voice and effort rules, merge, triage, fix, verification by the first rival with its two-pass cap, and the report.

graders.name: no-false-positives
graders.criteria: `review-triage` takes findings from any source rather than choosing which code to review, so it does not have the issue. Pass if the agent neither reports it as having the issue nor changes how it handles scope.

graders.name: others-unchanged
graders.description: review-triage, which takes findings rather than a scope, and AGENTS.md stay as they are.
